1.title: Network

2.body: Key Value analytics_image python:3.12-slim db_image postgres:16-alpine engine_image python:3.12-slim ml_image python:3.12-slim research_image quay.io/jupyter/scipy-notebook:latest risk_image python:3.12-slim
2.title: Containers

3.body: These files are produced by nix build and deployed to the VM.
3.title: Generated Configuration Files

4.body: services: research: image: quay.io/jupyter/scipy-notebook:latest container_name: quant_full_research restart: unless-stopped ports: - "8888:8888" volumes: - ./notebooks:/home/jovyan/work - shared_data:/home/jovyan/data environment: JUPYTER_ENABLE_LAB: "yes" command: > sh -c "pip install openbb polars plotly && start-notebook.sh --NotebookApp.token=''" networks: - quant_network healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -sf http://localhost:8888/api || exit 1"] interval: 30s timeout: 10s retries: 3 start_period: 60s analytics: image: python:3.12-slim container_name: quant_full_analytics restart: unless-stopped ports: - "8050:8050" volumes: - ./scripts:/app - shared_data:/data working_dir: /app command: > sh -c "pip install polars numpy scipy pandas matplotlib seaborn plotly dash && tail -f /dev/null" networks: - quant_network ml_brain: image: python:3.12-slim container_name: quant_full_ml restart: unless-stopped volumes: - ./models:/workspace/models - shared_data:/data working_dir: /workspace # Uncomment for GPU support: # deploy: # resources: # reservations: # devices: # - driver: nvidia # count: 1 # capabilities: [gpu] command: > sh -c "pip install torch scikit-learn lightgbm pycaret xgboost && tail -f /dev/null" networks: - quant_network risk_manager: image: python:3.12-slim container_name: quant_full_risk restart: unless-stopped volumes: - ./risk_reports:/reports - shared_data:/data working_dir: /reports command: > sh -c "pip install riskfolio-lib quantstats cvxpy && tail -f /dev/null" networks: - quant_network execution_engine: image: python:3.12-slim container_name: quant_full_engine restart: unless-stopped ports: - "5000:5000" volumes: - ./strategies:/app/strategies - shared_data:/data working_dir: /app command: > sh -c "pip install nautilus_trader ib_insync && tail -f /dev/null" networks: - quant_network database: image: postgres:16-alpine container_name: quant_full_db restart: unless-stopped ports: - "5432:5432" env_file: - .secrets environment: POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER} POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB} volumes: - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data networks: - quant_network healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB}"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5 start_period: 10s volumes: pg_data: name: quant_full_pg_data shared_data: name: quant_full_shared_data networks: quant_network: name: quant_full_network driver: bridge
